verdict.rationale: Databricks documents official MCP support: hosting managed/custom MCP servers, discovering and calling MCP servers (including MCP Service and Marketplace-listed MCP servers) from agent code, and wiring external clients (Claude, Cursor, MCP Inspector) to MCP servers hosted on Databricks. This is first-party documentation of an official MCP server integration point for agents. missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party corroboration of the MCP server working end-to-end, and more detail on auth/governance edge cases beyond docs.
